title: PrincipalType
description: Kind of protocol principal. The v0 protocol enumerates four runtime-agnostic kinds: person (a natural person), organization (a collective legal or social entity, including businesses, charities, and households), application (a software product acting on behalf of a principal), and system (an autonomous infrastructure actor). Verticals such as commerce or clinical practice are runtime concerns expressed via PrincipalProfile.attributes, not new principal kinds.
